desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Dragon Ball Escape ⚡🐉
Play as legendary Dragon Ball Legends and Villains while testing your reflexes in an action-packed speed escape challenge! 💨✨

🔴 How to Play:

* Every run increases your SPEED! ⚡
* Dodge dangerous obstacles and survive to reach the finish line! 🏃💨
* Unlock powerful Dragon Ball characters with unique boosts! 🔥
* Rebirth to unlock stronger perks and multipliers! 🚀
* Train and keep running to become the fastest player in the server! 💪⚡

⚙️ Features and Niches:

* Fast and smooth movement system 🌪️🦵
* Progressive speed scaling for exciting gameplay ⚡
* Unlockable Dragon Ball heroes & villains 🐉🔥
* Powerful upgrades and rebirth rewards 🚀
* NO level cap! Keep grinding and become unstoppable 😎

🌟 Race through epic Dragon Ball-inspired stages, break your speed limits, and prove you’re the ultimate warrior! 🌟

FREE PRIVATE SERVERS!
